rowSemantics.logicalRow: Each feature object is joined to its containing candidate object by candidateId. Candidate root, branch, revision, dirty state, project-source license, runtime-evidence catalogue and privacy/security concerns are inherited into every contained feature row.

rowSemantics.privacySecurity: candidate privacySecurityConcerns plus any capability-specific failureRestartIsolation and unknowns
